common.footer: Lost does not have to mean gone forever.
common.title: A lost item. A safe way back.
common.intro: Lost Key Finder connects finders and owners through a QR tag without exposing private contact details.
common.promise: No names. No detours. Just a direct way back.
common.stepsTitle: Return what matters, without sharing more than necessary.
common.scanText: Finders scan the QR code on your tag and leave a message.
common.confirmText: A secure email confirmation protects both sides from misuse.
common.connectText: You chat privately and arrange the return between you.
common.finderText: Scan the tag. We take care of the safe first contact.
common.notFoundTitle: This page could not be found.
common.loginPageIntro: Have you found something, or would you like to manage your own tags?
common.finderEntryIntro: Register a new tag or open an existing one.
common.tagHint: The tag ID is printed on the tag. You can also paste the complete tag link.
common.scanPreview: Camera preview for scanning the QR code
common.scanInstruction: Hold the QR code inside the marked area. The camera closes after scanning.
common.scanPrivacy: Camera frames and QR images are processed only on your device.
common.invalidTag: Enter a valid tag ID or a tag link from this website.
common.cameraFailed: The camera could not start. Check camera permissions, choose a QR image or enter the tag ID.
common.imageFailed: No valid tag QR code was found in this image. Choose another image or enter the tag ID.
common.foundUnavailable: A report cannot currently be started for this tag. Please try again later.
common.linkSentIntro: Your sign-in link has been requested. Open it directly from your email to sign in.
common.linkSentClose: You can close this page now. Sign-in continues in the browser opened by your email.
common.linkSentSpam: No email yet? Check your spam or junk folder as well.
common.linkSentDevice: If the link opens in another browser or device, confirm your email address there again.
common.requestAnotherLink: Use another address or request a new link
common.loginIntro: Sign in with a one-time email link. No password needed.
common.emailHint: Open the link from your email. Another browser or device works as well.
common.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
common.linkSent: Check your inbox. The link can only be used once.
common.linkFailed: The link could not be sent. Please try again later.
common.callbackEmailNeeded: Confirm your email address to open the sign-in link on this device.
common.callbackFailed: This link is invalid, expired or belongs to another browser. Request a new link.
common.accountIntro: You are signed in and can manage your tags.
common.accountBlocked: Access to this account is blocked.
common.accountFailed: Your account could not be loaded. Please try again.
common.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
common.logoutFailed: Sign-out could not be completed. Please try again.

tags.adminIntro: All tags in this environment, regardless of owner and origin.
tags.label: Label (optional)

tags.exportHint: Exports use this environment’s configured domain. Development data is not for production printing.

tags.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please try again later.
tags.adminDeleteConfirm: Retire this tag as an administrator? Its QR code will be deactivated. The record, owner reference and history are retained.
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete this self-created tag? Its QR code will be deactivated. The data is retained for history.

chat.title: Messages
chat.intro: Leave a private message for the owner. Your email address stays private.
chat.imageHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB and 2048 × 2048 pixels. Describe important image content in the text.

chat.closeHint: This makes all chats in this case read-only.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.consequences: Your self-created tags will be permanently retired. Hardware tags will be released for registration by another owner. Blocked or retired hardware remains blocked.
deletion.history: Your Firebase account and local contact details will be removed. Shared chat text, images and history remain available to other authorized participants; personal details you shared in this content are not automatically removed.
deletion.confirm: I understand the consequences and want to permanently delete my account.
deletion.recent: Please sign in using a fresh email link, then start deletion again.
deletion.failed: Deletion is not complete. You can retry; an account already blocked for deletion remains blocked.
deletion.resume: You can resume a started deletion on this page after signing in again.
deletion.doneText: Your account has been deleted. Signing in again will not restore previous tag or chat rights.
